clips.title: The story
paras: Across Ameth'Aran, Anaya's Pendant remains with the restless ghost of Anaya Dawnrunner. Cerellean Whiteclaw carries grief for the love he lost when the Sundering shattered their world.

When the Well of Eternity was destroyed ten thousand years ago, the ancient kaldorei city of Ameth'Aran fell into ruin. Cerellean Whiteclaw believed his beloved Anaya had perished, and carried his grief into a long sleep beside Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage. After waking, he wandered Darkshore and found Anaya's tormented apparition still drifting through Ameth'Aran, bearing the pendant. Cerellean cannot raise a hand against her himself, so he asks travelers to free her spirit and recover the heirloom.
